newsitem.title: POLAND: Optimus to change 20 convertible bonds.
newsitem.headline: Optimus to change 20 convertible bonds.

text.p: Polish computer maker Optimus SA has received orders to convert into shares another 20 of its 300 five-year convertible bonds at a par value of $100,000 each, the company said in a statement on Friday.

Optimus said that as a result its share capital would increase by 138,940 shares. The bonds are exchangeable into 6,947 common shares at $14.76 a share. Optimus closed on the Warsaw bourse on Friday at 113 zlotys.
Last month Optimus said orders to convert 159 of the bonds had led to the freeing up of provisions that helped boost January pre-tax profit.
The firm has said it would use its call option on the bonds sometime in this year's first half if it had not already received orders to convert them.
The conversion of all the bonds and their registration in court would bring the firm's number of shares outstanding to 6,484,108.
